item.title: Claude Cowork
item.description: Cowork takes the agent approach behind Claude Code and puts it in an ordinary app window. Instead of typing commands, you describe a job such as sorting a folder of receipts, turning notes into a report, or building a spreadsheet from several PDFs. Claude breaks the request into steps, makes a plan, works on the files you have shared with it, and reports back when it finishes. Files it reads or creates appear in a panel so you can open them.

item.title: Claude Design
item.description: Claude Design lets you make visual material by talking to Claude. Instead of dragging shapes in an editor, you ask for what you need, such as a slide deck for a product update, a landing page mockup, or a clickable prototype, and Claude builds a first version. You refine it with follow-up messages, like asking for a calmer color palette, a different layout, or an extra section, and the design updates.
